tools.name: pdl_person_enrich
tools.description: Find the single best-matching person profile for a set of identifying attributes (name, email, phone, profile URL, company, etc.). Returns one record plus a likelihood score (1-10), or a 404 'no match' body. Use uniquely-identifying inputs for best results. API: GET /person/enrich.

tools.name: pdl_person_identify
tools.description: Given broad, possibly-ambiguous attributes about a person, return up to 20 strongly-related profiles ranked by match score. Sits between enrich (1:1) and search (open-ended) — ideal when you can't uniquely resolve someone. API: GET /person/identify.

tools.name: pdl_person_search
tools.description: Search the full PDL Person Dataset with an Elasticsearch query object OR a SQL string over the Person Schema (e.g. everyone with job_title_role='engineering' at a company). Returns matching profiles sorted by completeness; paginate with scroll_token. Each returned record costs 1 credit. API: POST /p

tools.name: pdl_company_enrich
tools.description: Find the single best-matching company record. Requires a non-ambiguous input — name OR website OR ticker OR profile (website/ticker/profile resolve more reliably than name). Returns firmographics (industry, size, location, etc.) or a 404 'no match' body. API: GET /company/enrich.

tools.name: pdl_company_search
tools.description: Search the full PDL Company Dataset with an Elasticsearch query object OR a SQL string over the Company Schema (e.g. all SaaS companies with 50-200 employees in the US). Paginate with scroll_token. Each returned record costs 1 credit. API: POST /company/search.

tools.name: pdl_ip_enrich
tools.description: Enrich an IP address with its location, company, and (optionally) associated person data via a 1:1 match against PDL's IP dataset. API: GET /ip/enrich.

tools.name: pdl_autocomplete
tools.description: Get suggested values for a search field along with the number of available records for each — useful for building valid Person/Company Search queries. Free on all plans. API: GET /autocomplete.

tools.name: pdl_job_posting_search
tools.description: Search PDL's Job Posting Dataset (millions of active & historical postings sourced from company career pages) with an Elasticsearch query object OR a SQL string. Beta — may require plan access (HTTP 403 if not enabled). Each returned posting costs 1 credit. API: POST /job_posting/search.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pdl_person_enrich, pdl_person_search, pdl_company_search, pdl_job_posting_search · Private data: pdl_person_enrich, pdl_person_search, pdl_company_enrich, pdl_company_search, pdl_autocomplete · Public sink: pdl_person_enrich, pdl_person_search, pdl_company_search, pdl_job_posting_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pdl_person_enrich, pdl_person_search, pdl_company_search, pdl_job_posting_search · Private data: pdl_person_enrich, pdl_person_search, pdl_company_enrich, pdl_company_search, pdl_autocomplete · Public sink: pdl_person_enrich, pdl_person_search, pdl_company_search, pdl_job_posting_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
